capabilities: Manage projects in Table, Gantt, and Kanban views
Calculate critical path and total slack (CPM)
Capture schedule baselines and track variance
Analyze team workload and portfolio KPIs
extras: Not in the Obsidian Community Plugins store; manual install from GitHub only (build or download main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Optional Local HTTP/MCP API is off by default and binds to 127.0.0.1 with a token.
intentEvidence: personal spin-off built on top of the outstanding dotpm plugin
motivation: Created strictly for personal use to tailor the tool to the author's specific scheduling and project-control workflows.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run advanced project scheduling such as critical path analysis, baseline tracking, and typed dependencies over Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: personal spin-off built on top of the outstanding dotpm plugin

summary: Markdown-native project management plugin with Table, Gantt and Kanban views plus CPM scheduling, baselines, dependencies, and workload analysis.
